title: IZAKA-YA advertised a seven-day 100% annualized lending campaign
description: The operator announced that its normally advertised 12% annualized 10-day lending plan would be offered at 100% annualized for supported currencies during a seven-day campaign.

title: IZAKA-YA advertised a 500% annualized new-user lending campaign
description: The operator announced an introductory lending campaign describing a special 500% annualized interest reward for users making their first lending placement.

title: IZAKA-YA advertised a 1000% APR-equivalent transfer campaign
description: The operator announced a three-day transfer campaign targeting users moving assets from other exchanges, describing total rewards equivalent to 1000% APR with a 15,000 JPY-equivalent USDT cap. JPYR and IZKY were explicitly excluded from this campaign.

title: IZAKA-YA announced the 150 Festival campaign
description: The operator announced an August 11–24 campaign offering 100% annualized lending across selected durations and an additional transfer bonus described as an effective 150% annualized rate for qualifying users.
